datasetKind: Five individually sourced historical price observations; not a daily series
usage: Private educational research. No blanket redistribution license verified. Do not offer a provider-data download or describe this as open-licensed data. Cite individual sources alongside factual observations.
separation: OUTCOME/EVALUATION ONLY. Do not expose future prices or retrospective split factors to historical assumption-setting.
normalizedBasis: USD per share on post-June-2024 10-for-1 split basis
dividends: Excluded. These are price-only comparisons, not total shareholder returns. No dividend reinvestment or cash dividends included.

observations.reportedPriceType: Contemporaneous recent/end price, corroborated by dated exchange newspaper table; not independently certified official exchange close
observations.sourceTitle: Edward Jones Stock Table as of March 1, 2021

observations.reportedPriceType: Dated Banorte price table; contemporaneous news explicitly states Friday session ending price
observations.sourceTitle: Banorte weekly report, March 18, 2022, page 20, Indicadores Tecnicos (SIC)

observations.reportedPriceType: NVIDIA S-3 last reported sale price; not labeled official closing auction price
observations.corroborationNote: JPMorgan reference-stock table labels this same value Closing Price on February 27, 2023.

observations.sourceTitle: AP: Nvidia, Royal Caribbean rise; Rivian, Etsy fall, Thursday, 2/22/2024

observations.reportedPriceType: Quarter-end closing price in SEC-hosted Goldman Sachs 424B2; a later historical compilation, not an input available earlier in 2024
observations.sourceTitle: Goldman Sachs 424B2 historical NVDA prices, 2024 Q4 period end

limitations: Not an investable strategy backtest: four ex-post selected start dates and one common endpoint; unequal holding periods and hindsight/survivorship selection.
No daily paths, drawdowns, volatility, annual returns, execution assumptions, or annualized return supplied.
Prices reflect historical traded shares; do not compare them directly to retrospectively restated per-share fundamentals without aligning split bases.
Search-indexed and web-readable source evidence inspected; no paid API, account, or bulk download used. Original full documents not redistributed.
Banorte text table was readable, but screenshot retrieval failed; numerical row is corroborated by independent contemporary article.
Stooq browser verification and inaccessible terms prevented verification; no Stooq data downloaded. Yahoo official help says CSV download requires Gold subscription; no undocumented endpoint used.
